<thought>From the measurements we can deduce a simple series chain from node A to node B with intermediate nodes N_a1, N_a2, N_a3, X1, N_b1, N_b2, X2, N_c1, N_c2. The measured resistances between successive nodes match a series of resistors:  

- A‑N_a1 = 5 Ω  
- N_a1‑N_a2 = 10 Ω  
- N_a2‑N_a3 = 15 Ω  
- N_a3‑X1 = 20 Ω, X1‑N_b1 = 10 Ω (splitting the 30 Ω segment)  
- N_b1‑N_b2 = 15 Ω  
- N_b2‑X2 = 20 Ω, X2‑N_c1 = 10 Ω (splitting the 30 Ω segment)  
- N_c1‑N_c2 = 15 Ω  
- N_c2‑B = 20 Ω  

All other measured node‑to‑node resistances are consistent with the sum of the appropriate series segments, confirming this topology.

Thus the circuit consists of nine resistors (R1‑R8, with R4 and R6 each split into two series parts). The required JSON lists each resistor value and its connection.</thought>
